text:
maya: deploy-bot kicked off post-deploy synthetics for release r-2026. baseline p95=110ms, starting run against eu1
deploy-bot: [automated] smokewave run started: synth-id=svc-kv-eu1-0a7f; compare-baseline=110ms; timeout=5s
sam: saw p95 jump to ~820ms on the kv-prefill probe, a few 500s too. traces point to prefix-cache misses.
kai: confirming host-level metrics — some eu1 hosts reporting GC spikes and network retransmits around 08:12 UTC
tessa: hold the staggered rollout? current canary is at 30% in eu1.
maya: yes please hold. set traffic-weight eu1->0 for new variant and pin to previous stable v1.2.3
sam: pushing rollback-pin patch now. small note: downstream caches may still be warming, we should give ~2min after pin before re-evaluating.
deploy-bot: applied routing override -> pinned model variant v1.2.3 for eu1. canary traffic reduced to 0% at 08:15 UTC. record=rollback-pin, author=maya
obs-bot: synth-run update: before-pin p95=820ms (08:13), after-pin p95=140ms (08:18), error-rate -> 0.4% from 3.1%
kai: logs from a problematic host:
```
2026-03-21T08:12:42Z host-87 gc pause=1.8s net_retrans=12 prefix_fetch=504ms
2026-03-21T08:12:43Z prefixcache miss for key xq-9 -> backend fetch 490ms
```
maya: looks like cold prefix cache + occasional GC on a minority of hosts. plan: 1) pin (done) 2) drain and restart 3) re-run synthetic bucket for 10m
tessa: agree. kai — can you schedule the drain+restart on the 3 affected instances and coordinate a small warmup (prefill) job?
kai: on it. will rotate hosts one at a time, target completion by 08:30. warmup script will hit common prefixes at low concurrency.
sam: adding a quick check to the smoke policy to extend grace window for prefill-lag by +120s so we don't flip-flop on minor warming noise.
maya: FYI leaving notes in the rollout ticket and release notes: pinned eu1 to v1.2.3 due to prefill GC+net noise; planned host rotate and warmup. will reopen canary after 10m stable synths
deploy-bot: rollout note appended: "pinned eu1 -> v1.2.3; synth anomalies observed; host rotation scheduled; warmup started". ticket=INC-5491
obs-bot: post-warmup synth snapshot (08:29): p50=28ms, p95=135ms, 5xx-rate=0.2% -> within expected thresholds
tessa: thumbs. once kai confirms rotation complete, we can run a targeted canary at 5% for 15m and promote if stable. no rush.
kai: rotation done at 08:31. warmingJob logs show steady prefix hit-rate increase.
maya: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for 30m, will update when canary promoted or further action needed. :white_check_mark:
